children: NTPC Limited (NSE:NTPC) is scaling capacity with a 16 GW pumped storage plan, BESS rollouts and new PPAs (400 MW with ACME at ₹4.37/kWh), rising assets and capex, expanded supply allocations and stronger quarterly performance expectations as generation and solar revenue grow.
: NTPC plans a 16 GW pumped storage portfolio (1 GW Tehri operational; 15 GW DPRs underway) and 5 GWh BESS across 16 sites, with BESS commissioning from June 2027.
NTPC Q4 Expenses Up YoY; Fuel Costs Rise
: NTPC reported quarterly expenses up YoY to ₹48,059.30 crore, fuel costs ₹28,628.19 crore. Solar revenue rose to ₹1,138.23 crore from ₹722.52 crore.
NTPC Signs PPA With ACME Solar
: NTPC signed a PPA with ACME Solar for a 400 MW ISTS FDRE project, agreeing to buy power at ₹4.37 per kWh.
: NTPC Group gross fixed assets rose to ₹4,85,444 crore as of Sep 30, 2026, versus ₹4,37,142 crore a year earlier. Group capex for H1 FY27 was ₹23,932 crore, up from ₹23,115 crore.
NTPC Vidyut Vypar Nigam Starts BESS Operation
: NTPC subsidiary NTPC Vidyut Vypar Nigam started commercial operation of a 250 MW / 500 MWh battery energy storage system (BESS). No financials, dates, location, or counterparties were disclosed.
NTPC Extends Barh-I, Dadri-I; Farakka Supply
: NTPC extended 716.3 MW from Barh-I and Dadri-I to March 2028, supplied 330 MW from Farakka for November, and allocated 216.65 MW from Bongaigaon as long-term supply.
Tamil Nadu To Receive NTPC Power
: Tamil Nadu will receive long-term power from NTPC, sourced from Bongaigaon thermal and Subansiri hydro projects; allocations will be phased in proportionally as each unit is commissioned.
: Elara Capital sees NTPC (NTPC) likely to post stronger Jul–Sep 2026 quarter results on higher plant utilization and increased generation capacity; NTPC is named a top sector pick.
